agent_tone_reviewer.notes: The agent maintained excellent professionalism throughout an aggressive interaction, clearly explained policies and procedures, and successfully de-escalated tension while providing appropriate alternative solutions.

patient_tone_reviewer.notes: Patient displayed consistently hostile and impatient behavior throughout the call, using dismissive language and insults while eventually providing required information.

call_outcome_reviewer.notes: Patient's lab results inquiry was partially resolved with a nurse callback arranged, though the patient remained frustrated throughout the interaction.

coordinator_summary: Transcript bad_patient.txt captures a highly hostile patient (Mr. Daniel Cruz) demanding lab results over the phone. Agent Aisha performed exemplarily — remaining composed, upholding identity-verification and results-disclosure policies, and arranging a nurse callback as a compliant alternative. The patient was consistently disrespectful, used dismissive language, and issued a personal insult ("completely useless"), yet ultimately cooperated enough to confirm contact details. The call achieved a partial resolution: the underlying request (lab results) was not fulfilled on the call per policy, but a concrete next step (nurse callback) was clearly communicated. PHI was well-protected; no safety risk was identified and escalation to a supervisor was not required. Primary coaching opportunity is for the patient experience team to consider proactive portal onboarding to reduce this class of escalation.
